name: Twilio
description: Twilio automation: messages, calls, incoming phone numbers, conferences/participants, and recordings

a1a1.name: CreateMessage
a1a1.description: Send a message

a1a1.name: ListMessage
a1a1.description: Retrieve a list of Message resources associated with a Twilio Account

a1a1.name: FetchMessage
a1a1.description: Fetch a specific Message

a1a1.name: UpdateMessage
a1a1.description: Update a Message resource (used to redact Message `body` text and to cancel not-yet-sent messages)

a1a1.name: DeleteMessage
a1a1.description: Deletes a Message resource from your account

a1a1.name: CreateCall
a1a1.description: Create a new outgoing call to phones, SIP-enabled endpoints or Twilio Client connections

a1a1.name: ListCall
a1a1.description: Retrieves a collection of calls made to and from your account

a1a1.name: FetchCall
a1a1.description: Fetch the call specified by the provided Call SID

a1a1.name: UpdateCall
a1a1.description: Initiates a call redirect or terminates a call

a1a1.name: DeleteCall
a1a1.description: Delete a Call record from your account. Once the record is deleted, it will no longer appear in the API and Account Portal logs.

a1a1.name: ListIncomingPhoneNumber
a1a1.description: Retrieve a list of incoming-phone-numbers belonging to the account used to make the request.

a1a1.name: CreateIncomingPhoneNumber
a1a1.description: Purchase a phone-number for the account.

a1a1.name: FetchIncomingPhoneNumber
a1a1.description: Fetch an incoming-phone-number belonging to the account used to make the request.

a1a1.name: UpdateIncomingPhoneNumber
a1a1.description: Update an incoming-phone-number instance.

a1a1.name: DeleteIncomingPhoneNumber
a1a1.description: Delete a phone-numbers belonging to the account used to make the request.

a1a1.name: ListConference
a1a1.description: Retrieve a list of conferences belonging to the account used to make the request

a1a1.name: FetchConference
a1a1.description: Fetch an instance of a conference

a1a1.name: ListParticipant
a1a1.description: Retrieve a list of participants belonging to the account used to make the request

a1a1.name: FetchParticipant
a1a1.description: Fetch an instance of a participant

a1a1.name: DeleteParticipant
a1a1.description: Kick a participant from a given conference

a1a1.name: ListRecording
a1a1.description: Retrieve a list of recordings belonging to the account used to make the request

a1a1.name: FetchRecording
a1a1.description: Fetch an instance of a recording

a1a1.name: DeleteRecording
a1a1.description: Delete a recording from your account
